figures.caption: 基础式。把论文的策略评估目标记作 yᵏ，把平方误差记作 L_B；后文的保守项加在同一个误差之外。
figures.locator: §2 empirical Bellman policy-evaluation update; §3.1 Eq1 factor 1/2
source_notes: y^k denotes the sampled-transition Bellman target for a fixed target-policy pi. This is the paper policy-evaluation operator, without an added SAC entropy term; L_B is a local shorthand introduced for the article. r comes from the stored transition, not from a learned reward model. All Q,y,r values scalar, gamma discount.
figures.exact_latex: \begin{aligned} y^k(s,a)&=r(s,a)+\gamma\,\mathbb E_{a^\prime\sim\pi(\cdot\mid s^\prime)}[\widehat Q^k(s^\prime,a^\prime)]\\ \mathcal L_B(Q)&=\frac12\,\mathbb E_{(s,a,r,s^\prime)\sim\mathcal D}\\ &\quad\big[(Q(s,a)-y^k(s,a))^2\big]\end{aligned}
figures.visual_review: Final 290 px rendering inspected; symbols, signs, superscripts, subscripts, fractions and margins readable; no overfull box or missing glyph in TeX log.

figures.alt: CQL原公式1的逐项保守评估
figures.caption: 论文式（1），用 L_B 缩写。额外压低 μ 抽到的动作价值，代价是数据里的好动作也可能被压得过低。
source_notes: Exact Eq1 regrouped with L_B from eq01. mu uses the dataset state marginal and a chosen conditional action distribution; is not an OOD-state sampler. Support/count and sufficiently large alpha assumptions belong in prose.
figures.visual_review: Final 290 px rendering inspected; symbols, signs, superscripts, subscripts, fractions and margins readable; no overfull box or missing glyph in TeX log.

figures.alt: CQL原公式2的数据动作补偿
figures.caption: 论文式（2），等价拆开。第一项向下压，第二项在最小化时相对托住数据动作；L_B 继续约束它们符合已记录的回报。
source_notes: C_mu is article shorthand. Data expectation exactly equivalent to empirical sampled (s,a) pairs. Minus sign means minimizing the loss raises data-action Q relative to mu-action Q; Bellman term remains. It does not guarantee every individual Q is below its true value.
figures.exact_latex: \begin{aligned} \mathcal C_\mu(Q)&=\mathbb E_{s\sim\mathcal D}\!\big[\mathbb E_{a\sim\mu(\cdot\mid s)}Q(s,a)\\ &\qquad-\mathbb E_{a\sim\widehat\pi_\beta(\cdot\mid s)}Q(s,a)\big]\\ \widehat Q^{k+1}&\leftarrow\arg\min_Q\,[\mathcal L_B(Q)+\alpha\mathcal C_\mu(Q)]\end{aligned}
figures.visual_review: Final 290 px rendering inspected; symbols, signs, superscripts, subscripts, fractions and margins readable; no overfull box or missing glyph in TeX log.

figures.caption: 论文式（4），等价拆开。log-sum-exp 是平滑最大值；高估动作对它的贡献更大。
source_notes: Exact discrete-action Eq4 regrouped into Z_Q and C_H. In policy learning L_B target uses current pi_k as paper Eq4. For continuous actions this sum becomes an action integral estimated in eq09; entropy/KL weighting ambiguity in Eq3 is not silently propagated.
figures.exact_latex: \begin{aligned} Z_Q(s)&=\sum_{a\in\mathcal A}\exp Q(s,a)\\ \mathcal C_H(Q)&=\mathbb E_{s\sim\mathcal D}\!\big[\log Z_Q(s)\\ &\qquad-\mathbb E_{a\sim\widehat\pi_\beta(\cdot\mid s)}Q(s,a)\big]\\ \widehat Q^{k+1}&\leftarrow\arg\min_Q\,[\mathcal L_B(Q)+\alpha\mathcal C_H(Q)]\end{aligned}
figures.visual_review: Final 290 px rendering inspected; symbols, signs, superscripts, subscripts, fractions and margins readable; no overfull box or missing glyph in TeX log.

figures.alt: 保守项为何更用力压低虚高动作
figures.caption: 教学推导。只看一个状态的保守项：softmax 权重大于数据频率时，梯度下降会压低该动作的 Q；反过来则相对抬高。
source_notes: Partial derivative treats each per-state Q output as independent coordinate; actual parameter gradient sums these derivatives times network Jacobian and includes Bellman loss. No claim that neural-network Q components evolve independently. For data-free action beta=0 with positive sigma, gradient descent lowers Q.
figures.exact_latex: \begin{aligned} \sigma_Q(a\mid s)&=\frac{e^{Q(s,a)}}{\sum_b e^{Q(s,b)}}\\ c_H(s)&=\log\sum_b e^{Q(s,b)}\\ &\quad-\sum_b\widehat\pi_\beta(b\mid s)Q(s,b)\\ \frac{\partial c_H(s)}{\partial Q(s,a)}&=\sigma_Q(a\mid s)-\widehat\pi_\beta(a\mid s)\end{aligned}
figures.visual_review: Final 290 px rendering inspected; symbols, signs, superscripts, subscripts, fractions and margins readable; no overfull box or missing glyph in TeX log.

figures.alt: 表格更新与策略期望下界
figures.caption: 参照附录式（11）的经验表格教学改写。数据外倾向越强，扣减越大；令 μ=π 后，按目标策略平均的扣减非负，这是期望下界的关键。
figures.locator: Appendix C proof of Theorem 3.2, Eq11 and f(pi) nonnegativity argument (printed p18)
source_notes: Top is a teaching empirical-tabular rewrite of the first-order optimum of Eq2; the cited appendix Eq11 uses the exact Bellman operator. Empirical behavior probability must be positive; empirical Bellman uses pi and alpha must cover sampling error. D_pi(s) is an editorial nonnegative action-distribution deviation, distinct from the discounted state occupancy d_Mhat^pi in eq07. Bottom identity uses normalized pi and beta; mu=pi for lower-bound proof. This is not an exact parameter update formula for general neural networks or a guarantee for unsupported zero-count actions.
figures.exact_latex: \begin{gathered}\begin{aligned}\widehat Q^{k+1}(s,a)&=\widehat{\mathcal B}^{\pi}\widehat Q^k(s,a)\\ &\quad-\alpha\!\left(\frac{\mu(a\mid s)}{\widehat\pi_\beta(a\mid s)}-1\right)\end{aligned}\\ D_\pi(s)=\mathbb E_{a\sim\pi}\!\left[\frac{\pi(a\mid s)}{\widehat\pi_\beta(a\mid s)}-1\right]\\ D_\pi(s)=\sum_a\frac{(\pi(a\mid s)-\widehat\pi_\beta(a\mid s))^2}{\widehat\pi_\beta(a\mid s)}\geq0\end{gathered}
figures.visual_review: Final 290 px rendering inspected; symbols, signs, superscripts, subscripts, fractions and margins readable; no overfull box or missing glyph in TeX log.

figures.alt: CQL隐含的策略偏移惩罚与安全改进
figures.caption: 定理 3.5–3.6 的核心式。价值端的保守项隐含一个策略偏移惩罚；真实环境里的保证还要扣除误差项 ζ。
source_notes: Uses empirical MDP Mhat, real MDP M, discounted state distribution d_Mhat^pi. zeta is paper finite-sampling/empirical-improvement error expression, not set to zero. High-probability bound requires theorem assumptions and alpha; safe means return relative to behavior, not collision/hardware safety.
figures.exact_latex: \begin{gathered}D_{\mathrm{CQL}}(\pi,\widehat\pi_\beta)(s)\\ =\sum_a\pi(a\mid s)\!\left(\frac{\pi(a\mid s)}{\widehat\pi_\beta(a\mid s)}-1\right)\\ \pi^*\in\arg\max_\pi\Big[J(\pi,\widehat M)\\ -\frac{\alpha}{1-\gamma}\mathbb E_{s\sim d_{\widehat M}^{\pi}}D_{\mathrm{CQL}}(\pi,\widehat\pi_\beta)(s)\Big]\\ J(\pi^*,M)\geq J(\widehat\pi_\beta,M)-\zeta\end{gathered}
figures.visual_review: Final 290 px rendering inspected; symbols, signs, superscripts, subscripts, fractions and margins readable; no overfull box or missing glyph in TeX log.

figures.caption: 附录式（28）。C_H 超过预算 τ，α 增大；低于预算，α 减小。第二行是投影梯度上升的教学写法。
figures.locator: Appendix F Eq28 (printed p29); projected dual ascent is teaching expansion
source_notes: First line is Eq28 with article shorthand C_H/L_B. Second line projected-gradient-ascent explanation, not a claim of exact code optimizer/parameterization. [x]_+=max(0,x), eta_alpha positive; C_H over dataset states.
figures.visual_review: Final 290 px rendering inspected; symbols, signs, superscripts, subscripts, fractions and margins readable; no overfull box or missing glyph in TeX log.

figures.alt: 连续动作的20个样本重要性估计
figures.caption: 附录 F 的连续动作计算，改用积分记号并拆开权重。每个状态均匀采 10 个动作、当前策略再采 10 个，除以各自采样密度后估计 log 积分。
figures.locator: Appendix F Computing log-sum-exp, unnumbered importance-sampling formula (printed p29)
source_notes: Original appendix writes a sum even for continuous case; this explicitly uses integral for continuous action measure, u uniform probability density on bounded action space. Ten uniform and ten current-policy samples, density denominator retained. Logged estimator is finite-sample approximation; not an unbiased log estimate.
figures.exact_latex: \begin{aligned} a_i^u&\sim u(\cdot),\qquad a_i^\pi\sim\pi(\cdot\mid s)\\ w_i^u&=\frac{\exp Q(s,a_i^u)}{u(a_i^u)}\\ w_i^\pi&=\frac{\exp Q(s,a_i^\pi)}{\pi(a_i^\pi\mid s)}\\ \log\!\int_{\mathcal A}e^{Q(s,a)}\,da&\approx\log\!\left[\frac1{2N}\sum_{i=1}^N(w_i^u+w_i^\pi)\right]\\ N&=10\end{aligned}
figures.visual_review: Final 290 px rendering inspected; symbols, signs, superscripts, subscripts, fractions and margins readable; no overfull box or missing glyph in TeX log.

figures.alt: 随机候选与数据动作估值间隙
figures.caption: 附录式（8）。先在均匀抽到的候选动作里找最高估值，再减去数据动作的估值；正值说明随机候选更受 Q 偏爱。
figures.locator: Appendix B Eq8 (printed p15); Fig2 following page
source_notes: m_k(s) is an editorial shorthand for maximum over the sampled candidate actions. Random candidate max minus observed-action Q, not reversed. Monte Carlo estimate of max in continuous action space, not exact global max. N here is candidate count in diagnostic Eq8; do not equate it to the N=10 of the unrelated Appendix F importance estimator.
figures.exact_latex: \begin{aligned} a_1^\prime,\ldots,a_N^\prime&\sim\operatorname{Unif}(\mathcal A)\\ m_k(s)&=\max_{1\leq i\leq N}\widehat Q^k(s,a_i^\prime)\\ \widehat\Delta_k&=\mathbb E_{(s,a)\sim\mathcal D}\!\left[m_k(s)-\widehat Q^k(s,a)\right]\end{aligned}
